sec-hardening.text:
Randomize logarithms and powers
              Adds small numerical offsets to Math.log, log2, log10, log1p, and pow in pages and workers.
              Changes a math-fingerprint surface, but also changes values used by normal applications.
              Can break collaborative editor sync, serialization, and numerical data processing.
            
        

          
          Mask clipboard signals
              Hides copy, cut, and paste events, clipboard shortcuts, and paste-specific input metadata.
              The inserted text and ordinary typing remain visible to the website.
              Custom editors that depend on paste events may lose paste support.
            
        

          
          Mask window and tab activity
              Reports the page as focused and visible, and masks its reported fullscreen state.
              Hides window/tab departure events and keeps hover state and background timers active.
              Can interfere with fullscreen controls and increase CPU and battery use.
              Does not hide the real window, screen recordings, or changes you make in the editor.
            
        
      
        
        
          Optional hardening
          Each toggle trades compatibility for stealth. Off by default unless you flip it on.
        
      
      
        
          
          Disable window.nameReads return empty, writes ignored. Breaks fpscanner, popup-orchestrated auth flows.
        
        
          
          Disable WebSocketBreaks any site with realtime chat / live data feeds.
        
        
          
          Disable clipboard APInavigator.clipboard.read/write fails. Breaks paste-from-image and copy buttons.
        
        
          
          Disable EME (DRM)Breaks Netflix, Spotify Web Player, Disney+, Prime Video.
        
        
          
          Disable mediaDevicesnavigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices returns empty. Breaks WebRTC / Meet / Zoom / Discord.
        
        
          
          Hide notification permission stateNotification.permission always returns "default". Sites can't tell granted/denied.
        
        
          
          Hide storage.persisted statenavigator.storage.persisted() resolves false. Apps that need persistent storage break.
        
        
          
          Perturb Math.PI / Math.E etc.Off by default. Spec-defined IEEE constants — perturbing them flags as anti-fingerprinting. Trig functions are noised regardless.
        
        
          
          Hide timer-precision quantizationOn by default. performance.now() returns fractional ms via deterministic jitter, hiding Firefox's 1ms quantization.
        
        
          
          Disable timer quantization entirelyOff by default. Drops Spectre / audio-FP timing defenses. Only flip if you want raw precision.

sec-screen-management.text:
Chromium compatibility
        Screen API compatibility for desktop Chromium identities. Capture uses normal permissions and the sharing chooser. Reload affected pages after changing these settings.
      
        
        Virtual screen-management APIListed sites receive the selected number of virtual screens, using your Display persona. Extra screens repeat that geometry horizontally.

        Save origins
        Reset origins
      
      Use exact HTTPS origins, including any nondefault port. Paths and wildcards are excluded. An empty list disables access for all sites. Reset restores the initial TestDome entry.

findings.detail: 146 has a clear-overrides-during-generation checkbox. 157 always retains overrides during generation and offers a separate Clear overrides button.

findings.status: confirmed source and rendered options difference
findings.detail: CPU shortcuts 1, 6 and 64; platform shortcuts Linux armv8l, iPhone and iPad; audio channel shortcut 1 are absent. Custom editing remains available.

157 sidebar render overrides the eligibility-based hidden state. The screen panel is selectable with a Firefox identity while status says choose a desktop Chrome or Edge identity. The status paragraph also remains visible outside its category. This audit does not test native API eligibility or effectiveness.

findings.status: confirmed source ordering difference; failure not induced
findings.detail: 146 samples and checks requested OS/hardware before writing saved preferences. 157 writes mode/index/filter/seed preferences before sampling and has no rollback in its catch handler. Successful generation is covered by prior probes; failed generation preservation is not.
Ten controls use shortened inline help in 157 instead of the expanded 146 description lists. Their toggles remain present. All remaining aria-describedby targets resolve.
